newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Montreal sets virtual banking arm.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Montreal sets virtual banking arm.

text.p: Bank of Montreal said on Wednesday it has set up a new virtual banking enterprise offering a comprehensive range of banking services, to be operated in association with U.S.-based Harris Bank.
The bank said the enterprise, called mbanx, will offer banking services now available through the branch network without the constraints brought by time, space or geography.

For a C$13 monthly fee, retail clients of mbanx will receive unlimited transactions and a cash reward for the total value of their loans, mortgages, GICs and current balances consolidated with mbanx, Bank of Montreal said.
